```{r load libraries}
library(CellChat)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
```


#Read the data
```{r read the integrated scRNA data}
seu <- readRDS("/Volumes/My Passport/Final Data/HarmonyIntegrated_annotated_data_final.rds")

#subset the seu object based on the groups- nonsmoker, smoker and copd
seu.nonsmoker <- subset(seu, subset = orig.ident == "nonsmoker")
```


```{r non-smokers}
#Non smokers
# normalized RNA expression data
data.input2 <- GetAssayData(seu.nonsmoker, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

# metadata including cell types
meta2 <- seu.nonsmoker@meta.data

# assign the cell type information to a separate column
meta2$celltype <- meta2$predicted.ann_finest_level

# Use normalized RNA data (Seurat v5+)
data.input2 <- GetAssayData(seu.nonsmoker, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")

cellchat2 <- createCellChat(
  object = data.input2,
  meta = meta2,
  group.by = "celltype"
)

# set a ligand receptor db for human
cellchat2@DB <- CellChatDB.human  

cellchat2 <- subsetData(cellchat2)                 # subset expressed genes
cellchat2 <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat2)
cellchat2 <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat2)

#compute cell-cell communication
cellchat2 <- computeCommunProb(cellchat2)
cellchat2 <- filterCommunication(cellchat2, min.cells = 10)  # remove rare interactions
cellchat2 <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat2)
cellchat2 <- aggregateNet(cellchat2)

# Overall number of interactions
netVisual_circle(cellchat2@net$count, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat2@idents)), weight.scale = TRUE, label.edge = FALSE)

# Interaction strength
netVisual_circle(cellchat2@net$weight, vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat2@idents)), weight.scale = TRUE)

```


```{r B cell in NS}
#only choose B cells as senders and recievers

# See all interactions
head(cellchat2@net$weight)  # or subsetCommunication(cellchat)

# Filter communication involving B cells
bcell_interactions_ns <- subsetCommunication(
  cellchat2,
  sources.use = "B cells",   # use exact label from step 1
  targets.use = NULL
)

#check what cell types are there in interaction
unique(c(bcell_interactions_ns$source, bcell_interactions_ns$target))

# Suppose your Seurat cell type column is "predicted.ann_finest_level"
cells_to_keep4 <- colnames(seu.nonsmoker)[
  seu.nonsmoker@meta.data$predicted.ann_finest_level %in% unique(c(bcell_interactions_ns$source, bcell_interactions_ns$target))
]

length(cells_to_keep4)  # should now be >0

data_subset4 <- data.input2[, cells_to_keep4, drop = FALSE]
meta_subset4 <- seu.nonsmoker@meta.data[cells_to_keep4, , drop = FALSE]

dim(data_subset4)  # genes x cells

#make a B cell specific cellchat object
cellchat_b_ns <- createCellChat(
  object = data_subset4,
  meta = meta_subset4,
  group.by = "predicted.ann_finest_level"  # your cell type column
)

cellchat_b_ns@DB <- CellChatDB.human  

# Subset expressed genes and interactions
cellchat_b_ns <- subsetData(cellchat_b_ns)

# Identify over-expressed genes and interactions
cellchat_b_ns <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat_b_ns)
cellchat_b_ns <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat_b_ns)

# Compute probabilities of communication
cellchat_b_ns <- computeCommunProb(cellchat_b_ns)

# Optional: filter out rare interactions
cellchat_b_ns <- filterCommunication(cellchat_b_ns, min.cells = 10)

# Compute signaling pathway-level communication
cellchat_b_ns <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat_b_ns)

# Aggregate the network
cellchat_b_ns <- aggregateNet(cellchat_b_ns)

#circle plot with number of interactions

netVisual_circle(
  cellchat_b_ns@net$count,
  vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat_b_ns@idents)),  # size proportional to number of cells
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE
)

#circle plot with strength of interactions
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat_b_ns@net$weight,
  vertex.weight = as.numeric(table(cellchat_b_ns@idents)),
  weight.scale = TRUE
)

bcell_interactions_ns <- subsetCommunication(cellchat_b_ns)

write.csv(
  bcell_interactions_ns, 
  "~/Desktop/Bcell_interactions_ns.csv", 
  row.names = FALSE
)

```


```{r save rds}

saveRDS(cellchat2, file = "~/Desktop/cellchat_all_ns.rds")
saveRDS(cellchat_b_ns, file = "~/Desktop/cellchat_bcell_ns.rds")

```
